target_pattern: No Python code could be extracted from completion.
description: Prevents completion token window starvation on reasoning models (e.g. DeepSeek R1 distill) where CoT traces consume all tokens before code blocks are emitted; mandates max_tokens >= 8192 or scratchpad token limits.
negative_fixture: max_tokens = 4096 # thinking consumes 4096 tokens, emitting 0 code bytes
positive_fixture: max_tokens = 12288 # allows 4k-8k reasoning tokens followed by complete code emission
